title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024 in Zurich Oerlikon, a 23-year-old Chinese university student attacked three five-year-old boys with a knife, seriously injuring all three. One boy had a major vein severed and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest and nearly died from heart and blood vessel damage, and the third suffered wounds to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms and stopped him, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and anatomy, buying four kitchen knives, and practicing stabs on raw beef. He chose 1 October, China's national day, and posted patriotic messages shortly before the attack. He now faces trial for attempted murder, and the prosecution is asking for a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
